Retrieval occurs when we need to access a memory, and it relies on the activation of neural networks that were originally involved in encoding the experience. Emotional or contextually relevant cues can trigger recall, activating specific brain regions such as the amygdala for emotional memories or the prefrontal cortex for more complex thoughts and events.
